states.name: q
states.meaning: Registered D flip-flop output value, 0 or 1.
states.update_time: At each posedge of clk after the inputs d and r are sampled and the edge has settled.

rules.condition: At the sampled posedge of clk, r == 1; q is forced to 0.
rules.spec_quote: active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)

rules.condition: At the sampled posedge of clk, r == 0; q captures d.

reset.name: r
reset.first_released_cycle: The first posedge of clk at which r is 0 after a posedge with r is 1; q samples d on that same posedge.

mid: Optional mid input changes occur after sampling, before the other clock edge, and are carried to the start of the next row; these examples do not use mid changes.

uncertain.note: Clock-edge polarity is unspecified; the current rules assume posedge. A negedge-triggered D flip-flop would change when mid-cycle d changes are captured.
candidates: Positive-edge-triggered D flip-flop with active-high synchronous reset (current contract assumption).
Negative-edge-triggered D flip-flop with active-high synchronous reset (would capture mid-cycle d changes).
